```{r }
test3 <- readRDS("/groups/stark/lorbeer/STARR-TWIST/Oligos_with_motif_counts_2022code_subsettedmotifs_Ohlerincluded.rds")
enhancers <- test3[which(test3$`oligos_motif_counts$ID` %in% test1$ID),]
colnames(enhancers) <- c("seq_ID", "ETS", "SREBP", "Trl", "AP1", "GATA", "twist", "Ohler6", "Ohler8", "Dref", "Ohler7", "Ohler1")
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
main_mots <- c("ETS", "SREBP", "Trl", "AP1", "GATA", "twist", "Ohler6", "Ohler8", "Dref", "Ohler7", "Ohler1")
TF_motifs <- main_mots
names(TF_motifs) <- main_mots

enhancers$main_mots <- ""
for (x in names(TF_motifs)){
  column <- enhancers[[x]]  # Use [[ ]] for column extraction
  enhancers$main_mots <- paste0(enhancers$main_mots, ifelse(column == 0, "", paste0(x, "-")))
}
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
#count how many lines have which motif
#https://r-graph-gallery.com/128-ring-or-donut-plot.html
#https://rforpoliticalscience.com/2020/07/26/make-wes-anderson-themed-graphs-with-wesanderson-package-in-r/ 
TF_freq <- as.data.frame(table(unlist(lapply(strsplit(enhancers$main_mots, "-"), unlist(unlist)))))

#donut chart
# Compute percentages
TF_freq$fraction = TF_freq$Freq / sum(TF_freq$Freq)

# Compute the cumulative percentages (top of each rectangle)
TF_freq$ymax = cumsum(TF_freq$fraction)

# Compute the bottom of each rectangle
TF_freq$ymin = c(0, head(TF_freq$ymax, n=-1))

#install.packages("wesanderson")
library(wesanderson)
#wes_col <- c(wes_palette("Zissou1", 5, type = c("discrete")), wes_palette("Darjeeling2", 4, type = c("discrete")))
wes_col <- c("maroon3", "blue", "orange", "orangered1",  "darkblue", "steelblue2", "turquoise3","turquoise4", "tomato1", "darkred", "lightsalmon2")

# Make the plot
ggplot(TF_freq, aes(ymax=ymax, ymin=ymin, xmax=4, xmin=3, fill=Var1)) +
  geom_rect() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = wes_col) + 
  coord_polar(theta="y") + # Try to remove that to understand how the chart is built initially
  xlim(c(2, 4)) + # Try to remove that to see how to make a pie chart
  theme_void()

print(TF_freq)




```
